meta.name: app-store-screenshots
meta.description: App Store and Google Play screenshot creation with exact platform specs. Covers iOS/Android dimensions, gallery ordering, device mockups, and preview videos. Use for: app store optimization, ASO, app screenshots, app preview, play store listing. Triggers: app store screenshots, aso, app store optimization, play store screenshots, app preview, app listing, ios screenshots, android screenshots, app store images, app mockup, device mockup, app gallery, store listing

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按平台规格自动生成应用商店截图和预览视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为App Store和Google Play批量制作符合规格的截图
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate app store screenshots and preview videos with exact platform specs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch create platform-compliant screenshots for App Store and Google Play

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据平台规格生成 App Store 和 Google Play 截图，包括设备模型、图库排序和预览视频。
howto.when: 当你提到“应用商店截图”、“ASO”、“应用预览”等关键词，或要求制作 iOS/Android 截图时触发。

say.text: 为我的记账应用设计前 3 张截图，突出核心价值。
say.note: Claude 会遵循“前 3 张规则”生成截图。

say.text: 生成一个 15 秒的应用预览视频，展示主要功能。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合 Apple 预览视频规范的视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate App Store and Google Play screenshots with exact platform specs, including device mockups, gallery ordering, and preview videos.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'app store screenshots', 'ASO', 'app preview', or ask for iOS/Android screenshots.

say_en.text: Generate an iPhone 15 Pro fitness app screenshot at 1290x2796.
say_en.note: Claude will call tools to create a platform-compliant screenshot.

say_en.text: Design the first 3 screenshots for my budgeting app, highlighting core value.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the 'first 3 rule' for screenshot creation.

say_en.text: Create a 15-second app preview video showcasing main features.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a video meeting Apple preview specs.
